name: Network Report
summary: Generates an HTML report for a network (JGF), with a table of network properties and histograms of network and node attributes, optionally compared with null-model distributions, using igraph.
description: Loads the first network of a JSON Graph Format file with igraph (by default keeping only the giant connected component), tabulates its network-level properties and plots distributions of network and node attributes as PNG and PDF figures embedded in an HTML page. If a null-model network is given, its average distributions are drawn for comparison. Use it to inspect connectivity networks produced by other brainlife network Apps.

inputs.description: Input network used to generate a report.
Null model to be used as comparison for the distributions.

outputs.description: Report of the network, with plots and tables describing network properties.

citations.text: Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
Bassett D. S., Sporns O. Network neuroscience. Nature Neuroscience 20(3):353 (2017).
Costa L. da F., Rodrigues F. A., Travieso G., Villas Boas P. R. Characterization of complex networks: A survey of measurements. Advances in Physics 56(1):167-242 (2007).

failure_modes.message: The network file should contain at least one network.
failure_modes.fix: Provide a JGF file containing at least one network.
